calendarFeed.title: Reminders in your calendar
calendarFeed.lead: Subscribe your calendar to this link once: watering and care reminders for all your plants keep themselves up to date, with nothing else to do.
calendarFeed.urlLabel: For another calendar app (Outlook…), copy this link
calendarFeed.regenerateHint: Invalidates the previous link: calendars already subscribed to it will stop updating.
calendarFeed.failed: Couldn't load your calendar link. Try again in a moment.
calendarFeed.showOther: Not your usual calendar? See other options

oneAtATime.title: One due date at a time
oneAtATime.description: Each task only ever shows its next due date, not a full series: it updates itself automatically each time your calendar app resyncs, which can take up to 24h depending on the app.

google.title: Google Calendar & Android
google.lead: Click the button and confirm: the calendar also shows up on your Android phone signed into the same Google account.

apple.title: iPhone & Apple Calendar
apple.lead: On your iPhone or Mac, tap the button below and confirm the subscription in the Calendar app.
